question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The family heirloom was not only rare but was also _________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**priceless**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**priceless**" means something that is so valuable that it cannot be assigned a monetary value. (अमूल्य)
 
• The family heirloom being both rare and priceless emphasizes its immense sentimental or historical value.
 
• The other options: "**artist**," "**profit**," and "**productivity**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The family heirloom was not only rare but was also priceless__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Artist (कलाकार)**: refers to someone who creates art.
 
• **Profit (लाभ)**: refers to a financial gain.
 
• **Productivity (उत्पादकता)**: refers to the effectiveness of production.
